items.title: Tolu Smith said his biggest focus this offseason was physical conditioning.
items.author: Omari Sankofa II
items.body_excerpt:
Tolu Smith said his biggest focus this offseason was physical conditioning. 

Also, he’s shooting free throws left-handed now. “I’m naturally a lefty. I write with my left hand. It was just a matter of time, I think.”
